bio.text: Lynda Zamora Wilson, a Republican, represents District 9 (El Paso County) in the Colorado State Senate.
She was appointed to the seat in July 2025, succeeding Paul Lundeen.
She served in the U.S. Air Force from 1995 to 2020 and earned a Ph.D. from the University of California, Santa Cruz in 2013.
Her career experience includes working as an assistant professor of mathematics and economics at the U.S. Air Force Academy and as a senior economist at the Pentagon.
